note: DUAL-RUN OFF. enabled=false means no shadow reads and no write-through beside any production path, and THE FILE WINS: REDIS_DUAL_ENABLED=true in a job's environment cannot switch it back on. connect=true permits a deliberate job - probe, reconciler, request worker, keyspace viewer - to open a socket. A missing or malformed file reads as BOTH off. WHERE THIS FILE IS READ FROM MATTERS, and a previous version of this note got it wrong: in a checkout, editing it takes effect on the next call with no restart. In a Cloud Run job it is BAKED INTO THE IMAGE, so editing the repository copy changes nothing until a rebuild - set REDIS_DUAL_SETTINGS to a mounted copy if you want to operate it without one, and see cloud/bus-reconciler/REQUESTS.md. Nothing here stops an execution that is already connected. host stays empty because this repository is PUBLIC; it arrives as REDIS_HOST.
